name: copilot-harness
description: Harness engineering for GitHub Copilot: see how your agents, skills, instructions and prompts work together across sessions and repositories.

Generate Commit Message with BYOK Model - Stop

copilotHarness.snapshots.maxMegabytes.markdownDescription: Size cap of the snapshot store, in megabytes. The store keeps the figures of every Copilot session seen, so they survive Copilot deleting its logs. When the cap is exceeded the oldest records are removed first.

copilotHarness.byok.logLevel.description: Debug log level. Logs are written to the extension's global storage folder byok-logs as JSON lines. Default is 'off' (no logging).

copilotHarness.byok.baseUrl.description: The base URL for the Openai Compatible Inference API. Default value is Hugging Face.

displayName.description: (Optional) Display name for the model that will be shown in the Copilot interface. If not provided, will be generated automatically.

configId.description: (Optional) Configuration ID for this model. Allows defining the same model with different settings (e.g. 'glm-4.6::thinking', 'glm-4.6::no-thinking').

family.description: Model family (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3', 'gemini'). Enables model-specific optimizations and behaviors. Defaults to 'oai-compatible' if not specified.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the model provider. If not provided, the global copilotHarness.byok.baseUrl will be used.

context_length.description: Model support context length. Default is 128000.

vision.description: Model support vision. Default is false.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (range: [1, context_length)). Default is 4096.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (OpenAI new standard parameter).

reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort level for OpenAI-compatible requests. Leave empty to hide the Copilot picker.

type.description: Set to 'enabled' to enable thinking, 'disabled' to disable thinking

enable_thinking.description: Switches between thinking and non-thinking modes. Not required.

thinking_budget.description: Maximum number of tokens for chain-of-thought output. Not required.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (range: [0, 2]). Lower values make output more deterministic, higher values make it more creative. Default is 0.

top_k.description: Top-k sampling value (range: [1, Infinity)). Not required.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenRouter/xAI (high, medium, low, minimal, auto)

exclude.description: Exclude reasoning tokens from the final response

max_tokens.description: Specific token limit for reasoning (Anthropic-style, alternative to effort)

enabled.description: Enable reasoning (inferred from effort or max_tokens if not specified)

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent with every request to this model's provider. These headers will be merged with the default headers (Authorization, Content-Type, User-Agent).

include_reasoning_in_request.description: Whether to include reasoning_content in assistant messages sent to the API. Support deepseek-v3.2 or others.

apiMode.description: API mode: 'openai' (Default) for OpenAI Chat Completions (/chat/completions), 'openai-responses' for OpenAI Responses (/responses), 'ollama' for Ollama (/api/chat), 'anthropic' for Anthropic (/v1/messages), 'gemini' for Gemini (*/v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse).

useForCommitGeneration.description: Whether to be used for Git commit message generation. Not supports gemini apiMode.

delay.description: Model-specific delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. If not specified, falls back to global copilotHarness.byok.delay configuration.

cache_control.description: Enable Anthropic prompt-caching breakpoints (apiMode='anthropic' only). When true, attaches cache_control={type:'ephemeral'} to the system prompt and the last tool definition, and forwards any in-message cache_control markers emitted by Copilot. Set to false for upstream providers that reject the cache_control field.

copilotHarness.byok.models.description: A list of preferred models to use. If provided, these models will be used directly instead of fetching from the API.

enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3.

interval_ms.description: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 seconds).

status_codes.description: Additional HTTP status codes that will be merged. Default is [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

copilotHarness.byok.retry.description: Retry configuration for handling api errors like [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

copilotHarness.byok.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).

copilotHarness.byok.commitLanguage.description: Language for generated Git commit messages. Default is English.

copilotHarness.byok.commitMessagePrompt.description: Custom system prompt for commit message generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.

copilotHarness.byok.commitGitmoji.description: Start each generated Git commit message with a gitmoji for its type. Ignored when a custom commit message prompt is set.

copilotHarness.byok.prMessagePrompt.description: Custom system prompt for pull request title and description generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.

copilotHarness.byok.prBaseBranch.description: Branch a generated pull request message is written against. Empty uses the default branch of origin.

copilotHarness.byok.readFileLines.description: Number of lines to read when using `read_file` tool. Large lines may cost more tokens. Default is 0, let model decide lines.
